title: Talking with Orthodox Christians
tagline: Understand the East-West split, the Filioque and the papacy, and what Catholics and Orthodox already share.
whyItMatters: The Orthodox have valid sacraments, bishops and a rich liturgy; they are our nearest sister Church. Knowing their view fairly makes real dialogue possible.

mindset.tip: Begin with respect and with what we share: the sacraments, apostolic succession and the first seven councils. (CCC 1399; Unitatis Redintegratio 14-15)
Learn Orthodox belief from the Orthodox themselves before you describe it.
Remember the split had causes of language, politics and authority as well as doctrine; do not reduce it to one word.
Name the wounds on both sides honestly, and pray for unity. (John 17:20-23)
Be gentle with those who love their tradition deeply; give reasons with gentleness and respect. (1 Peter 3:15-16)
